versions.changelog:
Initial release of ai-model-expert-drama-gemini-api-relay.

- Provides a unified gateway for aggregating and managing Gemini/Google AI API model endpoints, keys, routing, quotas, audit, and async tasks.
- Supports key isolation, real-time model configuration, pricing snapshots, cost/speed/success-based routing, and rollback strategies.
- Includes scripts and blueprints for quick integration, connectivity testing, and async workflow management with AI-HIVE.
- Avoids shared or unauthorized tokens and ensures secure, compliant API relay for enterprise and content teams.
- Documentation covers usage scenarios, setup instructions, supported platforms, and safety/compliance guidelines.
